extracted.intended_audience: writers and creators using Substack (people starting, growing, or monetizing a Substack publication)
extracted.subtask_short: starting and growing a Substack publication
extracted.subtask_description: Practical, platform-specific guidance for launching, growing, and monetizing a Substack newsletter/podcast/video and building a reader community or media business on Substack. Covers fundamentals (setup, publishing, formatting), audience growth, going paid, podcasting/audio, community features, and business/legal/financial topics.
